result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but horizontal content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the bottom navigation overlaps the scrolling feed.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off on the right: a partial pill is visible after “Healthy,” with no clear end padding or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent trailing padding and ensure the horizontal carousel clips cleanly; optionally add a fade or other indication that the row is scrollable.

issues.description: Cards in the “Fastest near you” carousel are truncated at the right edge, including the third restaurant’s image, name (“Trattoria Picco...”), and delivery text.
issues.suggestion: Provide adequate end padding and card sizing so partial cards appear intentional, or use a carousel layout that keeps card content from being visibly cut off.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the content feed; the next popular restaurant card is hidden behind it at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation bar and safe-area height so all feed items can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The promotional banner says “3 free deliveries for you,” while several restaurant cards advertise delivery fees; although potentially valid, the conditions are easy to miss and may feel contradictory.
issues.suggestion: Make the promotion’s eligibility clearer on affected restaurant cards or add a concise note that the code/offer applies only to eligible orders.
